result.authentic: This is an authentic sustainability report, published by {{by}} on {{date}}. The document hash was anchored to a public timestamp calendar at publication time.

hash.title: Document hash
hash.howTo: Compute sha256sum on the PDF you received — it must equal the hash above. If it differs, the document has been modified.

anchor.title: External timestamp
anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.none: No external anchor on record. The document hash was stored server-side only.

assurance.none: This report was published without third-party assurance. The figures are management's representation. The document hash is still timestamped — integrity of the file is guaranteed — but independent opinion on the figures is not yet available.

manual.title: How to verify this report yourself
manual.step1: Open a terminal and run sha256sum report.pdf (or shasum -a 256 report.pdf on macOS). Compare the output to the hash above — they must match.
manual.step2: Install the OpenTimestamps client: pip install opentimestamps-client. This lets you independently confirm the anchor against the Bitcoin blockchain.
manual.step3: If the hashes match and the OpenTimestamps receipt upgrades to a full Bitcoin proof, this report has not been modified since it was published.
